payload.body: NEW - EU Parliament to vote next week on new legislation introducing a 2 category system for GMO products under "NGTs (New Genomic Techniques)," with NGT-1 final products no longer requiring mandatory GM labeling, as it can be perceived negatively and cause "limited consumer acceptance." Source: https://www.europarl.europa.eu/legislative-train/theme-sustaining-our-quality-of-life-food-security-water-and-nature/file-plants-produced-by-certain-new-genomic-techniques?sid=10201 @disclosetv
